title: [v0.92.1][V3-D] Materialize #503 terminal truth on main
body:
Part-Of #503
Part-Of #505
Part-Of #596
Part-Of #504

This PR materializes missing terminal records on current main-derived state and records the Sprint 5/6 closure-hygiene sweep.

Changes:
- Materializes #503 as `closed_out` from current main-derived state after live GitHub readback showed #503 already closed by merged PR #581.
- Restores #570 and #571 to closed only after live PR readback showed merged closing PRs with green checks and exact-head PASS review evidence, then materializes their terminal truth.
- Restores #500 to closed with an explicit historical-failure qualification because corrective #571 is now closed_out from merged PR #585 exact-head PASS evidence, then materializes #500 terminal truth.
- Restores #501 and #502 to closed only after live PR readback showed merged closing PRs with green checks and exact-head PASS review evidence, then materializes their terminal truth.
- Repairs #596 local ready-state truth after PR #597 merged with non-closing Part-Of linkage: stale design/diagram references are refreshed, STP/SPP linkage text no longer claims PR #597 closes #596, and SPP maps each acceptance criterion exactly once.
- Retains typed request evidence for terminal materialization of #500, #501, #502, #503, #504, #570, and #571.
- Retains typed v2 issue read/update request packets for the Sprint 5/6 closure-hygiene sweep.
- Restores #504 to closed after live PR #588 readback showed a merged closing PR with green checks and exact-head PASS review evidence, then materializes its terminal truth.
- Records that #505 and #596 remain open as live cutover/remediation gates.

Validation:
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 500`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 28.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 501`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 20.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 502`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 32.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 503`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 15.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 504`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 19.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 570`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 27.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 571`: pass, `phase: closed_out`, generation 14.
- `csdlc-validate issue --issue 596`: pass, `phase: ready`, generation 7.
- `git diff --check`: pass.
- Bounded pre-PR review: pass; typed v2 only, root main clean, live disposition truthful.

Non-claims:
- This PR does not cut over C-SDLC v3 authority.
- This PR does not claim #596 is terminal or closed_out; it restores #596 to a valid ready-state record and leaves it open.
- This PR intentionally uses non-closing issue relations because #500, #501, #502, #503, #570, and #571 are already terminal and #505/#596 must remain open.
head: codex/503-terminal-materialize
